speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You are early for a player. The pot is bean and a bone. Take the bowl while it is still a bowl.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I left the Keys at eleven. The Shrew was their bill at two. I was not in it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Then whose was it, sir, if you write for them and do not go?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The company's. A play may be played without the man who has another to open on Thursday.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Do not give me that plot with a ladle in my hand unless you can do it in one breath. I spent January on the new comedy, and I am not opening a second while I carry this.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The Shrew is an old one. A man wagers he can bring a wife to a quiet mind. That is the breath. I will not give you more while you have the pot.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: A wager on a wife is a bad household. I will not rule it off a single sentence. Bring me the plot on a day when the pot is down.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Was there a dinner in it?

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Alse. The bread is by your elbow. He is not a play for the scullery tonight.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There is dinner in this house. That is the dinner I came back for. Threepence, and I am at the table.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I had silk to carry at noon. I saw a bill at the Keys for the afternoon, and I did not stay.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You were right to stay at the work, Master Verbeke. The loudness was the yard. It was not an errand of yours.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Mark me. I do not keep a gallery. If the City wants a noise, it may have it south of my door.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The latch stuck when I came up with the coals. It sprang when I lifted it. I did not break it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: It sticks and it springs. I am not having it off the door tonight.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave it. It springs. That is enough of a door.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Thursday, then. Two of the clock, and the ladies have the better. I have not changed the mind I gave you in January.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I do not ask you to. Four young men, and dinner. You settled it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: And the ladies, sir. You told mistress they have the better. I should like to know if better means they eat.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Better means they do not lose. Eating is your question, and a fair one, and it is not the play's last word.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: A last thread, as yesterday. I will not pretend to learn a play from a bowl of beans.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. Learn the beans. There is a letter in his room, and it is not for this table.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is written. It waits for the carrier on the twenty-seventh. There is no errand in it for this house.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I left the candle you had. I did not take a house candle up to the desk.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Candles are his own. I counted them at noon, and I shall count them when he is done. That is a fact, not a fine.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: One for the letter if I read it back, and one to see the stair. I am not walking the chamber tonight.
